python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
from datetime import datetime
p='/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts/6fb55504-0196-4b32-b8a5-bc94d125456b/6fb55504-0196-4b32-b8a5-bc94d125456b.jsonl'
users=[]
asst_final=[]
with open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
  for line in f:
    o=json.loads(line)
    msg=o.get('message') or {}
    role=msg.get('role') or o.get('role')
    c=msg.get('content')
    text=''
    if isinstance(c,list):
      parts=[]
      for x in c:
        if isinstance(x,dict):
          if x.get('type')=='text': parts.append(x.get('text',''))
          elif 'text' in x: parts.append(str(x['text']))
      text='\n'.join(parts)
    else:
      text=str(c or '')
    # strip system noise
    if role=='user':
      # extract user_query
      m=re.search(r'<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>', text, re.S)
      q=m.group(1).strip() if m else text.strip()
      q=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',q)
      if len(q)>30 and 'available_subagent' not in q[:80]:
        users.append(q[:500])
    elif role=='assistant':
      # skip tool-only
      if text.strip() and not text.strip().startswith('{'):
        # keep substantial
        if len(text)>80 and 'tool_call' not in text[:40]:
          asst_final.append(text[:600])

print('=== USER QUERIES (%d) ==='%len(users))
for i,u in enumerate(users,1):
  print(f'---U{i}---')
  print(u[:400])
  print()
print('=== LAST ASSISTANT CHUNKS (%d), show last 8 ==='%len(asst_final))
for i,a in enumerate(asst_final[-8:],1):
  print(f'---A{i}---')
  print(a[:450])
  print()
PY
